references.text: The same chapter also mentions a female animal (a goat) as a sin offering, and the requirement that the animal must be without blemish
Describes the sin offering with a female animal from the small livestock, either a lamb or a goat
The requirement that the sacrificial animal from the small livestock must be without blemish (תָמִים)
The peace offering from the small livestock, including lambs, with the requirement that the animal must be without blemish
A lamb without blemish used in the cleansing ritual for leprosy
A female animal without blemish from the small livestock as a sin offering
The general requirement that sacrificial animals must be without blemish (תָמִים) to be accepted
Christ offered himself without blemish (ἄμωμον) as the fulfillment of the perfect sacrifice
Christ as a lamb without blemish (ἀμώμου) and without spot, fulfilling the sin offering
